title: What cloud providers does CloudDash support?
content:
## Supported cloud providers

CloudDash natively integrates with three major cloud providers:

- **Amazon Web Services (AWS)** — EC2, RDS, Lambda, CloudWatch, S3, EKS, ECS
- **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)** — Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Functions, Cloud Monitoring
- **Microsoft Azure** — Virtual Machines, AKS, Azure Monitor, App Services

No other providers (Datadog, New Relic, Splunk, Oracle Cloud, IBM Cloud, Alibaba Cloud) are currently supported as native integrations.

## How to connect a provider
1. Go to **Settings → Integrations** in your CloudDash dashboard.
2. Click **Add Integration** and select your provider.
3. Follow the credential setup: AWS uses IAM roles, GCP uses service accounts, Azure uses managed identities.
4. CloudDash will validate the connection and begin metric ingestion within 5 minutes.

## Multi-cloud and multi-account
You can connect multiple accounts from the same provider and across different providers. Use **tags** and **teams** to organize them.

## What is NOT supported
CloudDash does not currently integrate with Datadog, New Relic, PagerDuty, Splunk, or any third-party monitoring platform. If you need such an integration, please contact support to submit a feature request to the product team.
